name: Solve this quantum programming problem. Formulate MaxCut on the graph with edges
task_prompt: Solve this quantum programming problem. Formulate MaxCut on the graph with edges [(0, 1), (0, 2), (0, 4), (0, 6), (1, 2), (1, 4), (1, 6), (2, 3), (2, 4), (2, 5), (2, 6), (3, 4), (3, 6)] as a QUBO with dimod and solve it with SimulatedAnnealingSampler from dwave-samplers. Verify against brute force. Return the entire program in one piece, ready to run without any modification.
